notes.title: Major update is now live
notes.content:
Major update is now live.
The game is now easier . We fixed the time interval to the random colour changes so now you don't need to have godly reflexes ;) 
Be warned the game is still very challenging but now is 100% fair.
We fixed some minor bugs, and some performance issues to some low spec pc's.
We also fixed some bugs in the 3 infinite modes and the time intervals to the random colour changes.

notes.content: Into the TIMEverse is back again. Soon we will update the game by releasing a major balancing patch for the entire game. Details will be announced when the patch released.

notes.title: Orbi's chronicles
notes.content:
Orbi's chronicles is a humorous 2d adventure-rpg set in a dystopian alien planet.

The story of the game takes place in a dystopian alien planet.
Graphics are all handmade, and the cinematics are in motion comic style.
Combat system takes place on a board filled with 16 random letters, the longer the word you create, the greater the damage you do to your enemies.
In addition to from "spelling" battles the game has to offer many mini games in the form of "hangman" and "anagram" in order to disarm traps or activate ancient alien shrines.
Among others,there are many weapons to loot, in different rarities and chips to enchant them.
You can also choose between a variety of skills as you level up, either active or passive.
You can check it out, and add it to your wishlist if you like it ,at the link bellow:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492190/Orbis_chronicles/

notes.title: Time Attack
notes.content:
In this mode you have the full control of the player.
Try and finish the stage as fast as possible. You can also enable the ghost mode and compete against yourself. We intent to also add ghost mode to compete globally with other players. 
For now we added 2 stages and a brand new themed world the Volcanic planet.
More stages are coming along with a new campaign world in the near future.
As we promised the game will grow and grow for a long time.

notes.title: New game mode
notes.content:
A new game mode is in the works. You control the player.
We start working on new stages where you control the player.
That means new hazards,challenges and the time attack mode where you must complete each stage
as quick as possible. 
Compete with the ghost of player with the best time among the global leader-boards.
Worlds like Space city,Fragments and Time storm will have new stages and some new world themes are also will be created.
Some new skins will be added also.

As we mentioned before we intend to grow the game bigger and bigger and in the long run
Into the TIMEVERSE will be a huge game.
Every new addition to the game will be free. 

Thank you all.


P/S: We want to hear your ideas about the game and whats new to add.

notes.title: Infinite mode completed
notes.content:
We added 2 more world themes to the infinite mode.
You can find them at "Extras" menu.
To play these 2 worlds you have to unlock them first by finishing the second world of the main game to be able to play the 2nd world of infinite mode. The same applies for the 3rd world.

More content coming soon.

notes.title: Into the Timeverse is growing
notes.content:
Into the Timeverse grows bigger with the addition of the first portion of infinite  mode.
You can now go to Extras menu and click on Infinite mode. There you will see the first portion unlocked.
Leader-boards are also enabled.
Compete with others players globally and show them who's the best. ;) 

Minor bug fixes.
